heads.h: NEW on the dashboard meetings (office and leads)
heads.first: The Scramble, Lead and Foreman Meetings fill themselves from the app the first time each week's meeting opens. Prefill again at the top makes a fresh one.
+ Photo under any item, and + Add a photo to this section under the notes. On a phone you can take one or pick one.

The box that opens when you tap a job now always fits on the screen. Before, on a job low on the page, the Time buttons, Move, Book and Remove were cut off at the bottom. If the box is taller than the
Untick everybody on a job and it stays on its day in red, "Nobody on it". Tap it to add people.
Two half days on two jobs no longer show as double-booked.
The auto-schedule can no longer put someone on a job when they're already booked somewhere else that day. Two rare cases could still do it: a job that started late after a return trip and ran into an
Nobody can be double-booked anymore. If someone is already on a job at that time, or off, they're grayed out and can't be added, and Simpro booking refuses it too.
Every job on the calendar shows its time, like 7:00 AM–9:00 AM.

heads.h: FIXED for the office: pairs on the Crew Board
heads.first: Anyone can be paired with anyone now: a foreman with an apprentice, two leads, or people on different crews.
Approved time off shows on each day ("Off: names"). Nobody gets scheduled on a day they're off.

heads.h: NEW for the office: pairs on the Crew Board
heads.first: Settings › Crew Board: tap someone, then Paired with, to set who they go out with. A foreman, jr foreman or lead pairs with an apprentice or crew member on the same crew.
Tap + more on a busy day and that day's jobs open right over the calendar. Esc or a tap outside closes it.

heads.h: NEW for the owners: Friday Strategy on the dashboard
heads.first: Dashboard › Meetings has a fourth button, Friday Strategy · Fri 8:00. Only admins see it (owners and the office).
Edit under any row changes its words for that week's meeting. The job itself doesn't change.

heads.h: NEW for the office: the crew calendar
heads.first: Dashboard › Meetings and Forecast › Calendar now show a real calendar: a week view with each day's jobs, a Month view, and a 4 months view to see how far out work is scheduled.
Team phone list: a new card on My Day. It starts closed. Tap Open.

heads.h: NEW when you send a PO (Send to CED, New order from the bid)
heads.first: Under the CC box, tap Pick from team. Search a name and tick who to copy, up to 5. Tap Done picking.

heads.h: NEW on My Day (crew, leads, jr. foremen and foremen)
heads.first: Team rating and goals: a new card at the top of My Day, above My role. It starts closed. Tap Open.
Leads, jr. foremen and foremen: if you lead a job and someone is booked on it in Simpro today or tomorrow, a My jobsite card shows at the top of My Day.
Open /dashboard › Meetings and tap Foreman Meeting · Wed 7:00 at the top. One page for Koy and all three foremen.

heads.h: NEW (Dashboard: Meetings tab, the Scramble calendar)
heads.first: Open /dashboard, tap Meetings. The Calendar · all crews fold is at the top of the Weekly Scramble.

heads.h: CHANGED (Dashboard › Meetings › Lead Meeting, now laid out like the old Doc)
heads.first: Order is the Doc's: Notes, Highlight, Lowlight, Training, Schedule, Upcoming, Hours and margin, Crew out, Action items.

heads.h: REMOVED from the Lead Meeting: Open items from the watches, Needs, Hiring, When it comes up. (A week that already had notes typed in one of them still shows it at the bottom.)

heads.first: Open /dashboard › Meetings and tap Lead Meeting · Wed 6:30 at the top. The page remembers which meeting you picked.

heads.h: NEW (Dashboard: Meetings tab, the Weekly Scramble)
heads.first: Open /dashboard and tap Meetings (between People and Automations).

heads.h: NEW (Dashboard: the four weekly meeting pages)
heads.first: Open /dashboard. The closed row at the top of the Overview, Meeting and planning artifacts, now has 10 links instead of 6. Tap it to open the list.
Signing off a return trip now also clears its "needs scheduling" mark, so finished trips stop showing up as needing a date. Trips signed off before today keep the old mark until someone touches them.

heads.h: NEW (Quick jobs: Bid items and Material orders)
heads.first: Open any quick job. Under Material there are now two new folded sections: Bid items and Material orders.
